purpose: Run Algorithm 4.1 (projected gradient in t with reversible storage) on the 150 starts of the paper's first-order PB cohort, with three comparators sharing the objective, coefficient solver and stopping residual.
cohort: d in {5,10,20}, geometry in {0,1}, seeds 10-34 (config.start_centers); 150 starts

lbfgs.restart: after an abnormal return; stop after two returns without a 10% residual decrease

calibration: Settings fixed after a pilot on seed 9 (geometry 0, d=5), which is not in the cohort: alpha0=1 was accepted at every step; alpha0=8 or 32 was always reduced by backtracking without faster decrease per fit, and alpha0=32 produced trials outside the separation regions.
objective: production recovery energy with manufactured forcing, target-only constant omitted, divided by ||u*||_H^2; Sobol mixture quadrature power 12, seed 8128+100g+d; reaction 1
separation_check: a posteriori: boxes spanned by all evaluated trials, pair radius sqrt(max(t_max, 1.01 tau_out)); margin>0 means the run is a run of Algorithm 4.1 on regions satisfying the hypothesis of Theorem 4.1
amendment_1: Written after 17 runs (seed 10 only), before any further outcome was examined beyond those 17: the comparator pg_h (projected gradient in h) runs on seeds 10-14 only (30 starts) because each run reaches the 2500-fit cap (about 400 s); pg_t, lbfgs_t and lbfgs_h keep all 150 starts. Settings unchanged.
amendment_2: Written at 14:12 after 24 runs, by seed index only (no outcome-based selection): under the machine load each projected-gradient run takes about 10 minutes, so Algorithm 4.1 (pg_t) runs on seeds 10-14 (30 starts, all d and geometries) and the projected iteration in h (pg_h) on seeds 10-12 (18 starts); L-BFGS-B in t and h keep all 150 starts. Settings unchanged.
